title: Davis asks the APS historian in 1984 where anti-gravity research went
summary: Eric Davis tells of Davis asks the APS historian in 1984 where anti-gravity research went, about 1984 at American Physical Society meeting; Hughes Research Labs, Malibu, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: American Physical Society meeting; Hughes Research Labs, Malibu

tellings.quote: And I brought that up with the historian like what 1984 and Bob Forward at uh was still at the Hughes Research Labs in Malibu. He's the one that motivated me to ask that question because he had been looking at anti-gravity when he was at Hughes.
